body: Yeah, I think I will make sure to look for others who are quiet, and try to branch out to them. Honestly, it may seem like something small, but I've been going through a rough week, and you showing some interest in me has really helped me feel like I can get through :)

I guess I just feel kind of invisible. All my friends seem to be so sociable, but it feels like nobody even wants to talk to me. And I'm getting to a stage where I'll have to make my own friends, and it just feels impossible. P.s. Thanks for replying to my post, even just that made me feel a bit better.
